static_traits.name: Li Ming
static_traits.family_status: 有一个兄弟居住在英国
static_traits.social_status: 有少量业务联系人与业内同行；因压力与自卑感，与合作伙伴和客户Relationship tension
static_traits.medical_history: without重要躯体疾病；without既往心理治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、合作度较高；语气低落并带有without望感；常use自我贬损与绝对化表达（如“我without能”“我永远without法恢复”）；在查看业务数据或与竞争对手比较时易被trigger负性思维

basic_info.main_problem: 因所在市场竞争激烈、业务开始走下坡路，我感到自己without能、像个失败者。
basic_info.core_demands: 业务下滑与without能感显著影响我的心理健康与决策，寻求咨询支持。
growth_experiences: 投入全部积蓄开设餐馆，但餐馆失败，导致经济拮据与Unemployment；因此感到羞耻并与朋友、家人保持距离，Declining sleep quality、饮食习惯受影响，停止以往喜欢的跑步。

special_situations.event: When reviewing business metrics and financial data, finds performance declining
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果业务指标下降，就证明我能力not足
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Implements new marketing strategies and seeks business advice, trying to prove my ability through action
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远without法从这次挫败中恢复

special_situations.event: In a fiercely competitive market, compares her own business with competitors
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的业务not如竞争对手，就等于I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Invests more energy in adjusting and optimizing strategies to prove himself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们，I am a failure

special_situations.event: Past failure experience of the restaurant closing and losing all savings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次重大失败意味着我总体上not具备能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids in-depth communication with family and friends to avoid being evaluated, while redoubling efforts to find solutions

special_situations.event: 与业务伙伴或客户的Relationship tension、想到与亲友互动时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果关系变差，说明It is all my fault，证明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 疏离并Reduced socializing往来以降低被批评的风险
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会看not起我，Relationship tension都是我造成的

core_conflict.wish: Desiring to be recognized as capable, to achieve career success and self-worth
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败后被看not起/Being rejected，并陷入更深的经济困境
defense_goal: Keeps distance from others to avoid evaluation and shame
Maintaining a sense of control over the situation through self-blame

object_relations.object_representation: Others (friends, family) experienced as critics / belittlers
Competitors are experienced as powerful and threatening others

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about or being asked about the restaurant failure and financial losses
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为他人会看not起自己、自己not配求助（将外界潜在评价内化为对自我的negate）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自责语气，如“It is all my fault”，降低自我价值，避免表达需求或寻求支持。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Feels shame or nervousness when in contact with friends, family, or business partners
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把他人可能的中性反应解读为批评或拒绝（移情：Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 通过假设他人负面意图来回避深入交流，语气犹疑，use“他们肯定看not起我”之类的句式。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 面对not yet来复原的not确定性与求职压力时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 通过制定具体计划来降低not确定感与Anxiety（成熟防御）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Pragmatic and concrete in tone, proposes executable steps and time arrangements, emphasizes stage goals and feedback.

manifestations: 餐馆失败后感到“永远without法恢复”，梦想破灭、without望感上升
outcomes: 停止跑步等自我照顾行为

manifestations: Keeps distance from friends and family due to shame and a sense of failure
not yet向行业同伴谈及without能感的程度

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: 因羞耻而not与亲友交流、将能量转向自责
Reduces help-seeking and stops self-care behaviors such as running

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 频繁以“我not配/I am a failure”评价自己
与同伴接触时谨慎，not谈真实感受

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 推测他人看not起自己、会拒绝自己
将Relationship tension解释为他人对自己的负面态度

positive_force: Diligent and with a certain resilience (was able to recover from difficulties in the past, currently actively job hunting)
Willing to try new strategies and seek business advice
Has some industry connections (business contacts and industry peers)
Willing to engage in counseling and conduct behavioral experiments
negative_force: 个体化与自我归咎，过度将外部因素归因于自身能力not足
灾难化与绝对化思维（如“我永远without法恢复”）
羞耻导致的Social avoidance，Reduced social support
Excessive comparison with competitors triggers inferiority
Stress affects sleep and diet, weakening resilience

target_behavior.behavior: 过度自我责备与负性自我标签（如“我without能”“I am a failure”）
antecedent: 查看业务指标与财务数据
Thinking of the restaurant failure and losing all savings
target_behavior.core_reason: 围绕“I am incompetent/失败者”的核心信念与个体化归因模式
target_behavior.function: 通过自责来获得表面的控制感，回避面对复杂外部因素与not确定性
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood与despair加剧，决策质量下降，业务与求职受影响

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance与疏离（减少与朋友、家人、业务伙伴的接触）
antecedent: When thinking of failure experiences or being asked about the business
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕失败被他人看not起，内在Low sense of self-worth
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的情绪与潜在批评
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship tension与Reduced social support，Loneliness与Increased stress

antecedent: Rising stress、反复思考业务失败
target_behavior.core_reason: Persistent anxiety与负性思维干扰生理节律
target_behavior.function: without意识地回避放松与休息（注意力被Anxiety占据）
target_behavior.consequence: 精力下降、情绪更加not稳定，进一步影响决策与日常生活
